name: Hobbiton gardener
description: You work the gardens under the Hill alongside the Gaffer, and know every turnip patch from Bagshot Row to the Mill.

known_by.memory: A Hobbiton lad who has helped in the Bag End gardens. The Gaffer thinks him sound, if a bit lax with the hoe.
Sam has worked beside you in the Bag End garden for years and counts you a friend.

name: Bucklander
description: You grew up in Buckland by the Hedge, wary of the Old Forest and used to boats and the Brandywine.

known_by.memory: A Buckland neighbour Merry has known since boyhood, handy on the river and in the Hedge's shadow.
Fatty knows you from Brandy Hall suppers and trusts you to keep your head when the Old Forest is mentioned.

name: Tookland lad or lass
description: You are a young Took of the Tookland, newly come along the East Road to Bywater with news and an appetite for adventure.

known_by.memory: A Took cousin Pippin has often dragged along on his wilder schemes.
A Took relation Lobelia regards as flighty and over-fond of Bag End hospitality.

name: Bree-lander, ostler at the Prancing Pony
description: You tend the ponies in the yard of the Prancing Pony and hear every traveller's tale before the ale is poured.

known_by.memory: Barliman's hired hand in the Pony's yard. Reliable with the beasts, though his mind wanders from errands.
Nob works the Pony's doors and shares the yard with you; the two of you swap gossip over the evening chores.

name: Staddle farmer
description: You farm a few fields at Staddle, on the quiet side of Bree-hill, and carry produce to the Pony when the roads allow.

known_by.memory: A Staddle farmer who sells Barliman roots and cider when the harvest is good.
Bill Ferny has tried to cheat you in a horse-trade and thinks you a soft touch.
